## Change

Summarize the intent, linked implementation issue, and validation evidence.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass, including `npm test` and `npm run docs:check`.
- [ ] Build and package smoke checks pass (`npm run build`, `npm run test:dist`).
- [ ] No unrelated changes or secrets in the plan/commits.

## OKF knowledge definition of done (mandatory from M7)

- [ ] Updated **every affected** concept, decision, schema, API, or GitHub REST page (or explained why none is affected).
- [ ] Added a newest-first entry in `knowledge/log.md` with issue/PR context.
- [ ] Regenerated the README via `npm run docs:readme` when Concept summaries/order changed; preserved handwritten content.
- [ ] `npm run docs:check` passes (including frontmatter, indexes, timestamps, links and generated README).

See [knowledge maintenance policy](https://github.com/attention-spa/gh-plan/blob/main/docs/knowledge-maintenance.md).
